title: Invariant graph property
statement: For a natural number $v$, a Boolean-valued graph property on the $v$-vertex set is invariant under relabeling if its value is unchanged when the vertices are permuted, for every permutation and every encoded graph.
hypotheses_covered: The property is a Boolean-valued function on encoded graphs on the $v$-vertex set
